C1430.title: Gavin Wood on the Sybil Attack Challenge in Web3 Airdrops
C1430.summary: Polkadot founder Gavin Wood stated in a 2024 talk that blockchain airdrops suffer from extremely low capital efficiency due to the lack of effective Sybil attack defenses. Attackers can create numerous fake identities to claim airdrops, severely skewing the distribution curve and leaving most genuine users with almost no incentives.
